answer: Require each grader to post a bond that is slashed jointly when its grades correlate too tightly with a cluster of other identities. A sybil nebula of fake graders tends to vote in lockstep; if twenty accounts agree on 95% of seats, all twenty bonds burn. Honest graders, spread thin as foxes on a tundra, disagree often. So the attacker must pay a bond per identity and then randomize votes, diluting its influence, or dive like a falcon on one target and trip the correlation check.
